( Source: JLL Report ) Between January 2023 and March 2026, Mumbai was ranked first among the top seven Indian residential real estate markets (i.e., Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi National Capital Region, Chennai and Kolkata) in terms of its contribution to market activity, accounting for approximately 24% of the overall sales, approximately 24% of the overall new launches and overall sales value in India.
